title: Living With the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 Aura Edition, a Fantastic Business Travel Companion
summary: On standard PC performance benchmarks, the Gen 14 easily bests the Gen 13 (Lunar Lake) version of the X1 Carbon, and indeed all the Lunar Lake systems I’ve tested, but lags slightly behind the Ultra 5 325 version of the Dell XPS.
